cards.front: Lisa me dice que Matt no ha hecho nada que merezca la pena desde 2005.
cards.back: Lisa tells me Matt hasn't done anything worthwhile since the year 2005.

cards.front: Tom me dice que Lisa compró una camisa muy bonita ayer.
cards.back: Tom tells me Lisa bought a really nice shirt yesterday.

cards.front: Matt me dice que Tom va a casa de su hermano todos los sábados.
cards.back: Matt tells me Tom goes to his brother's every Saturday.

cards.front: Andrés nos dijo que la empresa de Melissa no ganaba mucho dinero.
cards.back: Andrés told us Melissa's company didn't make a lot of money.

cards.front: Andrés nos dijo que Lea ganaba mucho más dinero que Ian.
cards.back: Andrés told us Lea earned a lot more money than Ian.

cards.front: Andrés nos dijo que le parecía lógico porque Lea trabajaba más.
cards.back: Andrés told us it made sense to him because Lea worked harder.

cards.front: Eloísa le dijo a Alison que se iban de vacaciones a Kazajistán.
cards.back: Eloísa told Alison they were going on holiday to Kazakhstan.

cards.front: Eloísa le dijo que sus vecinos también se iban de vacaciones a Kazajistán.
cards.back: Eloísa told her her neighbours were going on holiday to Kazakhstan too.

cards.front: Eloísa le dijo que todos sus conocidos se iban de vacaciones a Kazajistán.
cards.back: Eloísa told her everybody she knew was going on holiday to Kazakhstan.

cards.front: Inés le dijo a Richard que Lucas iba a hablar con un par de inversores sobre el proyecto.
cards.back: Inés told Richard Lucas was going to talk to a couple of investors about the project.

cards.front: Inés le dijo que Matt y Melanie iban a hablar con Recursos Humanos.
cards.back: Inés told him Matt and Melanie were going to speak to Human Resources.

cards.front: Inés le dijo que ella no iba a hablar con nadie de nada.
cards.back: Inés told him she wasn't going to talk to anybody about anything.

cards.front: Ella me dijo que no iban al cine ese fin de semana.
cards.back: She told me they weren't going to the cinema that weekend.

cards.front: Él nos dijo que tenía que comprar suficiente comida para veinte personas.
cards.back: He told us he had to buy enough food for twenty people.

cards.front: Os dije que iba a fregar los platos.
cards.back: I told you I was going to do the dishes.

cards.front: Sally me dijo que Miriam había estado prometida con un soldado durante tres años.
cards.back: Sally told me Miriam had been engaged to a soldier for three years.

cards.front: Sally me dijo que después Miriam había estado prometida con un actor famoso.
cards.back: Sally told me after that Miriam had been engaged to a famous actor.

cards.front: Sally me dijo que luego Miriam había vuelto a estar soltera durante seis años.
cards.back: Sally told me then Miriam had been single for six years.

cards.front: Jo les dijo a los espectadores que había llovido a cántaros en el norte de España el día anterior.
cards.back: Jo told the viewers it had rained cats and dogs in the north of Spain yesterday.

cards.front: Jo les dijo que había granizado en el este de Inglaterra durante todo el día.
cards.back: Jo told them it had hailed in the east of England all day.

cards.front: Jo les dijo que había lloviznado durante unas horas en el sur de Alemania.
cards.back: Jo told them it had drizzled for a few hours in the south of Germany.

cards.front: Sebastian le dijo a Megan que había tenido sesenta días libres desde enero.
cards.back: Sebastian told Megan he'd had 60 days off since January.

cards.front: Sebastian le dijo que sus amigos le habían comprado muchos regalos por su cumpleaños.
cards.back: Sebastian told her his friends had bought him lots of presents for his birthday.

cards.front: Sebastian le dijo que lo habían ascendido tres veces desde 2008.
cards.back: Sebastian told her he had been promoted three times since 2008.

cards.front: Tino le dijo que Alberto cuidaría de su perro la semana siguiente.
cards.back: Tino told him Alberto would look after his dog next week.

cards.front: Richard le dijo que Alberto revisaría sus propuestas a la mañana siguiente.
cards.back: Richard told him Alberto would look over his proposals tomorrow morning.

cards.front: Kyle le dijo que él y Alberto buscarían la letra de la canción en Internet.
cards.back: Kyle told him he and Alberto would look the lyrics of the song up on the internet.

cards.front: Raúl les dijo a sus amigos que no tardaría mucho en podar los rosales.
cards.back: Raúl told his friends it wouldn't take long to trim the rose bushes.

cards.front: Raúl les dijo que no tardaría mucho en cambiar las cuatro ruedas del coche.
cards.back: Raúl told them it wouldn't take him long to change the four tyres on his car.

cards.front: Raúl les dijo que no tardarían mucho en montar el andamio.
cards.back: Raúl told them it wouldn't take them long to put the scaffolding up.

cards.front: Steve me dijo que no soportaba a alguien que se pasara el día preguntándose qué hacer después.
cards.back: Steve told me he couldn't put up with someone wondering what to do next all day.

cards.front: Steve me dijo que no podía evitar hurgarse la nariz todo el día.
cards.back: Steve told me he couldn't help picking his nose all day.

cards.front: Steve me dijo que estaba deseando conocer a otra persona.
cards.back: Steve told me he couldn't wait to meet someone else.

cards.front: Jamie le dijo a Tony que quizá rompiera con Sue.
cards.back: Jamie told Tony he might break up with Sue.

cards.front: Jamie le dijo que quizá se mudara solo a Chicago al año siguiente.
cards.back: Jamie told him he might move to Chicago on his own the following year.

cards.front: Jamie le dijo que quizá buscara otro trabajo en Chicago.
cards.back: Jamie told him he might look for another job in Chicago.

cards.front: Phil les dijo a sus amigos que Pam no debería gastarse tanto dinero en ropa.
cards.back: Phil told his friends Pam shouldn't spend so much money on clothes.

cards.front: Phil les dijo que Pam no debería comprarles tantos regalos a los niños.
cards.back: Phil told them Pam shouldn't buy the children so many presents.

cards.front: Phil les dijo que Pam debería lavar el coche más a menudo.
cards.back: Phil told them Pam should wash their car more often.

cards.front: A nosotros nos dijo que trabajaría dos días a la semana si no necesitara el dinero.
cards.back: He told us he'd work two days a week if he didn't need the money.

cards.front: A nosotros nos dijo que se quedaría en casa el resto de la semana si ganara la lotería.
cards.back: He told us he'd stay at home the rest of the week if he won the lottery.

cards.front: A nosotros nos dijo que se compraría un deportivo si tuviera más dinero.
cards.back: He told us he'd buy himself a sports car if he had more money.

cards.front: Juan te dijo que podía que no fuera a la boda de Iván.
cards.back: Juan told you he might not go to Ivan's wedding.

cards.front: Melissa le dijo a ella que no podría asistir el lunes a las dos de la tarde.
cards.back: Melissa told her she couldn't make it on Monday at 2 pm.

cards.front: Paul me dijo que no distinguía a Bach de Beethoven.
cards.back: Paul told me he couldn't tell the difference between Bach and Beethoven.

cards.front: Él me dijo que llamara a los proveedores para preguntar por el pedido.
cards.back: He told me to phone the suppliers about the delivery.

cards.front: Él me dijo que organizara una reunión con el departamento de finanzas.
cards.back: He told me to arrange a meeting with the Finance Department.

cards.front: Él me dijo que hablara con el contable.
cards.back: He told me to speak to the accountant.

cards.front: Él nos dijo que no dejáramos bebidas cerca de la fotocopiadora.
cards.back: He told us not to leave drinks near the photocopier.

cards.front: Él nos dijo que no sobrecargáramos la bandeja de papel.
cards.back: He told us not to overload the paper tray.

cards.front: Él nos dijo que no moviéramos la fotocopiadora cuando estuviera encendida.
cards.back: He told us not to move the photocopier when it was switched on.

cards.front: No nos ordenó que gestionáramos las quejas de los clientes; se lo ordenó a ellos.
cards.back: He didn't tell us to handle the customer complaints; he told them to do it.

cards.front: No nos ordenó que preparásemos las hojas de cálculo; se lo ordenó a ellos.
cards.back: He didn't tell us to create the spreadsheets; he told them to do it.

cards.front: No nos ordenó que escribiéramos el orden del día para la reunión del día siguiente; se lo ordenó a ellos.
cards.back: He didn't tell us to type the agenda for the following day's meeting; he told them to do it.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no nos mandó que gestionáramos las quejas de los clientes?
cards.back: Why didn't he tell us to handle the customer complaints?

cards.front: ¿Por qué no nos mandó que preparásemos las hojas de cálculo?
cards.back: Why didn't he tell us to create the spreadsheets?

cards.front: ¿Por qué no nos mandó que escribiéramos el orden del día para la reunión del día siguiente?
cards.back: Why didn't he tell us to type the agenda for the following day's meeting?

cards.front: Le dijimos a ella que preparara el material para las presentaciones.
cards.back: We told her to prepare the materials for the presentation.

cards.front: Le dijeron a ella que no emitiera las facturas aún.
cards.back: They told her not to issue the invoices yet.

cards.front: ¿Por qué le dijiste que no repartiera la correspondencia recibida?
cards.back: Why did you tell him not to distribute the incoming mail?

cards.front: La gente suele decir que solo los borrachos y los niños dicen la verdad.
cards.back: People say only drunks and children tell the truth.

cards.front: Alguien dijo: dile a un amigo una mentira; si la mantiene en secreto, entonces dile la verdad.
cards.back: Someone said, "Tell your friend a lie. If he keeps it secret, then tell him the truth."

cards.front: Mark Twain dijo: si dices la verdad, no tienes que recordar nada.
cards.back: Mark Twain said, "If you tell the truth, you don't have to remember anything."

cards.front: Zac Efron dijo que una chica podría distinguir cuándo le gustaba si se ponía rojo o empezaba a contar chistes malos.
cards.back: Zac Efron said a girl could tell he liked her when he blushed or started telling bad jokes.

cards.front: Will Rogers dijo que él no contaba chistes, sino que se fijaba en el Gobierno e informaba de los hechos.
cards.back: Will Rogers said he didn't tell jokes. He just watched the government and reported the facts.

cards.front: David Lean le dijo a la gente que no contara chistes sobre la comida.
cards.back: David Lean told people not to tell jokes about food.

cards.front: Isak Dinesen dijo que ser persona era tener una historia que contar.
cards.back: Isak Dinesen said being a person was having a story to tell.

cards.front: Steven Spielberg dijo que la gente había olvidado cómo contar una historia.
cards.back: Steven Spielberg said people had forgotten how to tell a story.

cards.front: Jean Houston dijo que si seguías contando la misma historia triste, seguirías viviendo la misma vida triste.
cards.back: Jean Houston said if you kept telling the same sad story, you would keep living the same sad life.

cards.front: Nunca le cuentes un secreto a una novia o a un novio; espera a que lleven casados un tiempo.
cards.back: Never tell a secret to a bride or a groom; wait until they have been married longer.

cards.front: Claro que puedo guardar secretos; es la gente a la que se los cuento la que no puede guardarlos.
cards.back: Of course I can keep secrets. It's the people I tell them to that can't keep them.

cards.front: No se me dan bien los secretos, así que no me cuentes ninguno.
cards.back: I'm not good at secrets, so don't tell me any.

cards.front: Ella sabe decir la hora en cinco idiomas.
cards.back: She knows how to tell the time in five languages.

cards.front: Gracias a Dios no podemos predecir el futuro; nunca nos levantaríamos de la cama.
cards.back: Thank God we can't tell the future. We'd never get out of bed.

cards.front: Aprendí a decir la hora cuando tenía seis años.
cards.back: I learned how to tell the time when I was six.

cards.front: Me dijeron que venías.
cards.back: I was told you were coming.

cards.front: Le dijeron a él que iba a llover.
cards.back: He was told it was going to rain.

cards.front: Le dijeron a ella que habría al menos cinco.
cards.back: She was told there would be at least five.

cards.front: No nos dijeron que estuvieras aprendiendo inglés.
cards.back: We weren't told you were learning English.

cards.front: No nos dijeron que tuvieran una habitación libre.
cards.back: We weren't told they had a vacancy.

cards.front: No les dijeron que fuese la última parada.
cards.back: They weren't told it was the last stop.

cards.front: No me dijeron que llegara aquí media hora antes de tiempo.
cards.back: I wasn't told to get here half an hour early.

cards.front: No le dijeron que llevara corbata.
cards.back: He wasn't told to wear a tie.

cards.front: No le dijeron a ella que hiciera la reserva del vuelo sin decírtelo.
cards.back: She wasn't told to book the flight without telling you.

cards.front: Nos dijeron que lleváramos los pasaportes todo el tiempo.
cards.back: We were told to carry our passports at all times.

cards.front: Les dijeron que no cerraran las puertas con llave por la noche.
cards.back: They were told not to lock their doors at night.

cards.front: Nos dijeron que pusiéramos nuestra alarma a las seis de la mañana.
cards.back: We were told to set our alarm clock for 6 am.

cards.front: ¿No te dijeron que estuve aquí?
cards.back: Weren't you told I was here?

cards.front: ¿No le dijeron a él que veníamos?
cards.back: Wasn't he told we were coming?

cards.front: ¿No les dijeron que vistieran formalmente?
cards.back: Weren't they told to dress formally?
